images.alt: a side-by-side screenshot of an egui-rendered and a CLI-rendered UI for the same music player

text:
was idly vibing out a TUI version of blackbird (my subsonic client/music player) between work tasks today using Claude Code Web, and I'm pretty happy with how it turned out, given that I haven't written any code for it

I especially like the quantised album art covers; they're pretty cute
